lines: Scotland, December 1900. A supply ship nears a lonely lighthouse.
Flannan Isles, out in the stormy Atlantic. Three keepers live here.
But nobody waves. The light had been dark for days.
A man climbs up and finds empty beds and a stopped clock.
Legend says a chair lay overturned, the meal still on the table.
Two raincoats were gone. Had they rushed out into a storm?
Some blamed a giant wave. Others said spies, serpents, or ghosts.
The three keepers were never found.
What do you think happened out there?
title: Three Keepers Vanished From a Lighthouse in 1900... 🌊 #shorts
description:
In December 1900, a ship reached the remote Flannan Isles lighthouse in Scotland and found it empty: a stopped clock, a missing coat, three keepers gone. This is the Flannan Isles mystery, and it was never solved.
